sections.heading: The Mandate: Path to $130M
sections.narrative: Achieving our revenue target requires a bifurcated strategy: defending our core ACP/MSP base against hyperscaler pricing pressure, while capturing net-new revenue in cloud-native and AI infrastructure.

sections.heading: Market Calibration (2026-2027)
sections.narrative: Our Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM) is strictly defined as 15% of the Global TAM, explicitly excluding captive hyperscaler workloads.

sections.heading: Benchmark-as-a-Service (BaaS)
sections.narrative: Transitioning from static datasheets to interactive solution engineering. We do not guess performance; we demonstrate it.
